details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (revenue, EBITDA, net profit), K2 (passenger and cargo volumes), K3 (key performance drivers including weak confidence, geopolitical tensions, fleet optimization, and depreciation adjustments), K6 (net debt reduction and cash flow impacts), and K8 (emissions reduction strategy). However, it omits core material components for K4 (specific fleet management details including vessel sales and lay-up reductions), K5 (segment performance details for Estonia-Finland, Finland-Sweden, and Estonia-Sweden routes), K7 (capital investments and maintenance days), and K9 (post-reporting-period management changes). While several HIGH importance criteria are fully covered, the missing MEDIUM criteria—particularly K4 and K5—represent meaningful omissions that prevent the summary from achieving full coverage.
